horoscope: The Moon spends the day in your sign, dear Aries, and your emotions are on your sleeve. Still, you may have additional obligations to attend to, but you're up to the challenge. With today's Moon, you're attracted to spending time doing productive things, dear Sagittarius, finding it soothing and satisfying to do so.
